questions.question: Which of the following describes the typical Gram stain appearance of Streptococcus species?

options.explanation: Gram-negative rods describe bacteria like E. coli or Pseudomonas, not Streptococcus.
Gram-positive cocci in clusters are characteristic of Staphylococcus species, not Streptococcus.

options.text: Gram-positive cocci in chains or pairs
options.explanation: Streptococcus species are classically described as Gram-positive cocci arranged in chains or pairs.
Gram-negative cocci in pairs are characteristic of Neisseria species, not Streptococcus.

questions.explanation: Streptococcus species are Gram-positive cocci that typically arrange in chains or pairs, which helps differentiate them from other Gram-positive cocci like Staphylococcus.
